faqItems.question: Can I be seen today for a dental emergency?
faqItems.answer: Yes, Fortson Dentistry offers swift, compassionate emergency dental care when you need it most. Please call us immediately to schedule your urgent appointment and get relief.

faqItems.question: What constitutes a dental emergency?
faqItems.answer: A dental emergency includes any situation causing severe pain, trauma like a knocked-out or broken tooth, severe infection, or uncontrolled bleeding. If you're in pain, it's an emergency.

faqItems.question: How much does an emergency dental visit cost?
faqItems.answer: The cost of an emergency visit depends on the specific treatment needed. Fortson Dentistry accepts most major PPO insurance plans, including Delta Dental®, and offers flexible financing through CareCredit® and Cherry™ to help manage costs.

faqItems.question: Do you accept walk-ins or offer after-hours appointments for emergencies?
faqItems.answer: While we recommend calling ahead, we provide immediate emergency dental care. Our hours extend to 6 PM on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, and we focus on getting you seen quickly when an emergency strikes.

faqItems.question: What should I do if a tooth gets knocked out?
faqItems.answer: If a tooth gets knocked out, contact us immediately. Handle the tooth by the crown, rinse it gently if dirty, and try to reinsert it into the socket. If not possible, keep it moist in milk or saline and bring it to our office right away.

faqItems.question: Do you take dental insurance for emergencies?
faqItems.answer: Yes, Fortson Dentistry welcomes Delta Dental® and most major PPO plans for emergency treatments. Our team can help you understand your benefits and explore payment options.

doctor.name: Cory Fortson
doctor.bio: Dr. Cory Fortson is a third-generation dentist, proudly continuing a family legacy started over 30 years ago by his grandfather and father. Graduating from The University of Detroit Mercy Dental School, Dr. Fortson joined the practice in 2014 and took over in 2016. He leads Fortson Dentistry in providing personalized, high-quality dental care, ensuring every patient feels welcomed and receives exceptional treatment.

reviews.name: Melanie S.
reviews.text: Dr. C. Fortson is the best. He genuinely cares, immediately responds and followed up with me post surgery. His authentic compassion is unmatched! I highly recommend Fortson Dentistry for urgent care.

reviews.name: LaVerne R.
reviews.text: We were there today and Dr. Waller serviced us both professionally and courteously! Staff is great and never a long wait time! Highly recommend this dental practice for emergencies.

reviews.name: Ashanti V.
reviews.text: The experience was real nice. She did not hurt me at all. There was a small pain but once she doped me up with the numbing shot it did the trick. She was very gentle with me during my urgent procedure.

reviews.name: Helena P.
reviews.text: The office staff is friendly. My dental health is great. Can't ask for much more than that! They make coming in for emergencies stress-free.

reviews.name: Kayla B.
reviews.text: All of the staff are like family now because they actually get to know their patients! I also appreciate how patient they are with my children during unexpected visits! Seriously the best dentist office!

reviews.name: Wanda K.
